g.text: COMPONENTS DESIGNATED BY ( ) ARE SUPPLIED BY INSTRUMENT MANUFACTURER.
KEEP WITHIN TORQUE REQUIREMENTS OF MANUFACTURER WHEN INSTALLING SENSOR.
ANGLE OF PROPAGATION IS CHOSEN TO FOCUS ON THE PROCESS LIQUID, CLEAR TANK SIDE
WALLS, STATIONARY PARTS OF THE TANK.
TRANSDUCER TO HAVE BUILT-IN TEMPERATURE COMPENSATION.
PIPE NIPPLES SHALL BE SCHEDULE 80, MAXIMUM 30mm FROM PROCESS PIPE OR PIPE LAGGING.
